notes.title: Small patch! :)
notes.content:
Hey all!

So a small patch has gone through to fix an issue with leaderboards displaying the wrong time! I will be keeping my eyes open for any issues that will arise and hope to have some new content coming to the game soon!

Once again I thank you all for playing! This was a small project made in between college classes and was a blast to make!

Stay safe!

Frog

tags.bug: fix an issue with leaderboards displaying the wrong time
